When you need a little extra help, grab a second solano!  Sometimes two is better than one!🤩

Beauty Pros: Be sure to register your Pro Account for exclusive pricing. 

All solano dryers are backed by a 2-year warranty.  Our service center offers speedy repair & refurbishment services for all dryers, regardless of make. 😉
